website | pages show as a site
* say it again | teach it to a friend
say: And you do everything by saying it. The command line speaks plain words. Type a name to make a tile. Type a slash, then say what to do. Say present, and your hive shows as slides. Say website, and its pages show as a site. Nearly every act in Hypercomb has a word, and the rest are getting theirs, so what you do, you can say again, teach to a friend, and remember. The language belongs to its community, too: people translate it into their own tongue and offer it on a host, and any hive that follows that host can take their words in.
